==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|playing-card||dated}}

===Etymology===
From {{compound|en|playing|card}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Qwertygiy-playing card.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
[[File:Karty do gry . Playing card.JPG|thumb|right|150px|'''Playing cards'''.]]
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q47883}}{{lb|en|cards}} A [[piece]] of [[specially]] [[prepared]] [[card stock]] or [[thin]] [[material]] [[bearing]] [[identify]]ing [[symbol]]s such as a [[number]] and [[suit]], used [[primarily]] for [[card game]]s, and generally forming part of a [[deck]] of such cards.
#: {{syn|en|card<id:Q47883><qq:{{glossary|elliptically}} synonymous>}}
#: {{hyper|en|card<id:flat stiff paper-or-plastic object etc><qq:broad sense>}}

====Related terms====
* {{l|en|card game}}
